Internal/PIIPropertyScanner.cs.reason: Reflection-based property scanner; its branches are reached through unit tests and generated DTOs. The guard flag is not in defaultTests because the type is internal and has no ThrowIfNull, so there are no guard lines to cover.

justifications.unit: Every branch (property, class, log-only, precedence, non-string unmaskable, get-only) is reached through GetProperties by the scanner unit tests; only the ArgumentException catch of CompileSetter is unreachable with a plain DTO (measured 97%).
justifications.property: Property tests run the scanner through MaskObject and MaskForLog on generated DTOs; the unmaskable and class-level log branches are covered by unit tests (measured 76%).

Internal/PropertyMaskingMetadata.cs.reason: Compiled property accessor metadata used by the scanner. The guard flag is not in defaultTests because the type is internal and has no ThrowIfNull, so there are no guard lines to cover.

justifications.unit: Constructor, GetValue and the throwing SetValue branch of the no-setter case are exercised by the scanner and masker unit tests (measured 91%).
justifications.property: Property tests build the metadata through the scanner and read and set values on generated DTOs (measured 77%); the no-setter branch is covered by unit tests.

MaskingOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults and validation

justifications.unit: Every branch of LogMasked (disabled level, success through MaskForLog, failure placeholder) runs with the real masker and mocks (measured 100%).
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the logger and masker null checks of LogMasked and its three level wrappers (measured 28%); the rest is behaviour covered by unit tests.

PIIMasker.cs.reason: Core masker with ThrowIfNull guards and masking invariants. Property tests verify round-trip and format invariants.

justifications.unit: MaskForLog (option off, success, failure rethrow with EventId 8023) and the Tokenize-as-Redact branch of the log context are executed by the log-context unit tests with the real masker (measured 93%).
justifications.guard: Guard tests only exercise the ThrowIfNull lines of the public methods including MaskForLog (measured 11%), the rest of the masking engine is behaviour covered by unit tests.
justifications.property: Property tests run the object-masking engine through MaskObject and MaskForLog with generated strings (measured 44%); the remaining lines are option and failure branches covered by unit tests.

PIIMaskingPipelineBehavior.cs.reason: Pipeline behavior with ThrowIfNull guards on constructor

justifications.unit: Defaults, setters, validation and ToString of the options are exercised by PIIOptionsTests (measured 100%).
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the null and range checks of the options setters (measured 57%); the remaining lines are defaults and ToString covered by unit tests.

PIIOptionsValidator.cs.reason: Options validator with a ThrowIfNull guard on Validate

justifications.unit: Both opt-out warnings (AllowUnkeyedHash and MaskInLogs = false, EventId 8019 and 8024) and their once-per-process behaviour run with a FakeLogger and the real validator (measured 100%).
justifications.guard: Guard tests execute the ThrowIfNull of Validate and the failure paths up to the log branches (measured 78%); the opt-out logging is behaviour covered by unit tests.

justifications.unit: Unit tests build the provider for AddEncinaPII and resolve every registration (measured 97%).
justifications.guard: No guard test exists for this registration and this change only edits comments; the ThrowIfNull is executed by the unit tests.
